payload.detail: PARTIAL 2026-09-18 (PR #2881, merged). /api/registry/records now emits degraded (only when true), parseRegistryListResponse accepts it in both the full and search allow-lists, and the services/forms document-search surface renders it through withCatalogueDegradedNotice on the results heading and catalogueDegradedNotice on the count band. A latent bug was fixed in the same pass: registryListPayload returns matches for every non-summary view once the request carries q, and matches was in neither allow-list, so a searched list request would have parsed as null and told the reader the registry could not be searched for a response that arrived completely intact. Regression-tested in both views. STILL OPEN, which is why this row is not closed: (1) /api/medications emits the same state as retainedSnapshot: true and no medications surface renders it; (2) services-navigator-page.tsx and forms-search-results-page.tsx read the same registry list, own their own header bands, and show no notice.
